decisions.label: Quest buff strength
decisions.note: Every done quest's buff, this many times as strong as written, however far its dream creature lived (the encounter is the gamble, not the reward). A relic's stays as written.

decisions.label: Dreams from later areas
decisions.note: On: a legend dreams of a kind living in an area later on the route than its own (deeper in). Off: any kind on the map, as before.
